name: Dublin City University
description: Dublin City University is a public university in north Dublin, opened in 1980 as the National Institute for Higher Education, Dublin, and granted university status in 1989. It has about 18,000 students across five faculties including business, engineering and computing, and education.
whyIncluded: DCU is one of Ireland's public universities, and Ireland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: DCU Student Support 'Cost of attending University 2025/2026 - living away from home' (dated 25 June 2025), monthly averages: housing = rent for a single room EUR 796 + gas/electricity/oil EUR 125 + internet EUR 30 + bin charges EUR 18; food = groceries/toiletries EUR 200 + campus meals EUR 120; transport = local transport EUR 92 + weekend travel outside Dublin EUR 140; personal = phone EUR 27 + medication EUR 22 + college materials EUR 10 + books EUR 24 + TV licence EUR 13 + extra-curricular EUR 45 + clothing and social EUR 145. DCU's own monthly total is EUR 1,822 (EUR 16,398 for September-May). No 2026/27 version was published when checked.

programmes.name: BSc in Computer Science (DC121)
programmes.notes: DCU Fees Office undergraduate schedule 2026-2027, 'Non EU Fee' column; 4-year degree. All programme fees are per annum and subject to an annual increase. programmes.name: MSc in Diagnostics and Precision Medicine (DC739)
programmes.notes: DCU Fees Office postgraduate schedule 2026-27, Faculty of Science and Health, full-time 'Non EU Fee' (EUR 23,000 per annum); School of Biotechnology, 1 year full-time (2-4 years part-time, priced per module: EUR 1,000 per 5-credit module, EUR 5,940 dissertation). The schedule says Science and Health programmes 'are subject to the fixed registration charge of EUR 130 plus levy of EUR 40', which applies to the modular (part-time) route; the full-time figure is used here and the compulsory fee kept as the Student Centre levy (EUR 43) per the other DCU records. Fees are per annum and subject to an annual increase. Chosen because DCU's physics, chemistry and biotechnology MScs are research or modular only. 2025/26 history: non-EU fee (EUR 17,000 per annum) from DCU's 'Postgraduate Fees 2025-26' schedule; the live URL now redirects to the 2026-27 page, so the 2025-26 figure was read from Common Crawl's September 2025 capture of that page (secondary read of the official schedule).
